scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('client/package.json')){cp.execSync('cd client && npm install && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}else{cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
